cards.text: Describe your day as a weather forecast; passing is always okay.
Draw an imaginary mascot in the air with one finger; passing is okay.
Invent a two-line jingle for a nearby object; passing is okay.
Give a sincere compliment to someone who is comfortable receiving it; passing is okay.
Make up a title for the last book or show you enjoyed; passing is okay.
Tell a short story using three words chosen by the group; passing is okay.
Do a dramatic reading of a sentence from a public sign; passing is okay.
Invent a friendly greeting for the group; passing is okay.
Hum a tune for others to guess, or choose another prompt; passing is okay.
Describe an imaginary holiday in one sentence; passing is okay.
Make a tiny paper sketch of a made-up creature; passing is okay.
Say a tongue twister slowly, or pass without explanation.
Create a sound effect for a cartoon door; passing is okay.
Name three things that are blue without looking around; passing is okay.
Pitch a new flavor of ice cream in twenty seconds; passing is okay.
Tell a joke you enjoy, or simply pass; no explanation needed.
Invent a new name for a familiar room; passing is okay.
Make up a short motto for the group; passing is okay.
Describe an ordinary object as if it were a museum treasure; passing is okay.
Create a two-step seated dance move, or pass; no one needs to perform it.
Speak one sentence like a calm documentary narrator; passing is okay.
Draw a tiny map to an imaginary place; passing is okay.
Invent a helpful robot and describe its one job; passing is okay.
Say one nice thing about a place you have visited; passing is okay.
Create a safe superhero name for yourself or a fictional hero; passing is okay.
Give a weather report for an imaginary planet; passing is okay.
Make up a new word and explain its meaning; passing is okay.
Describe your favorite snack like a food critic; passing is okay.
Create a three-word team cheer, or pass; no shouting is needed.
Tell a story that begins with “Somehow, the teacup knew”; passing is okay.
Invent a tiny award and say who might enjoy receiving it; passing is okay.
Make a gentle sound effect for a scene in a silent film; passing is okay.
Describe a color without naming it; passing is okay.
Create a short advertisement for clean water; passing is okay.
Name a fictional shop and what it would sell; passing is okay.
Say a familiar phrase as if it were a grand announcement; passing is okay.
Invent a polite way for a robot to ask for directions; passing is okay.
Describe a perfect reading nook in fifteen seconds; passing is okay.
Make up a title for a song about doing the dishes; passing is okay.
Share a word you like the sound of, or pass; no reason required.
Create a friendly mascot pose while seated, or pass; no photos needed.
Invent a gentle greeting for someone arriving late; passing is okay.
Summarize a favorite story in exactly five words; passing is okay.
Describe a cloud as if it had a job; passing is okay.
Say one encouraging sentence to the whole group; passing is okay.
Create a name for a tiny imaginary island; passing is okay.
Make up a harmless mystery about a missing spoon; passing is okay.
Describe an everyday sound as a musical instrument; passing is okay.
Invent a new indoor game that needs no equipment; passing is okay.
Offer a choice of another card instead; passing is always okay.
